summary: A six-voice polysynth modelled loosely on the Roland JUNO-60, with one DCO per voice, a resonant low-pass filter and the classic stereo chorus. The sound is an approximation, not a circuit model.
features: Saw, pulse with PWM, sub and noise; 24 dB filter plus 4-position HPF
Chorus I, II and I+II; poly, unison and solo modes with portamento
Arpeggiator and a 16-step recorder with rests
56 factory memories, selectable by MIDI program change
USB MIDI in with a CC for every parameter; no MIDI out or SysEx
Browser editor over Web MIDI; six screen colour themes

headings: j6: a juno-60 style firmware for the m-vave fm-1
